descriptions.en:
Produced by a Fomorian's power core, these particles only appear on or around planets where a Fomorian is present.

Location: When a Balor Fomorian is threatening a Planet's Relay, enemies on that Planet will drop this resource
descriptions.zh:
由巨人战舰动力核心所产生，这些粒子仅出现在巨人战舰活动当地或邻近的星球上。 

获取地点：当巴罗尔巨人战舰威胁到星球中继站时，该星球的敌人便会掉落这种资源

descriptions.en: Orokin modification technology used to super-charge weaponry. Doubles the available Mod Capacity on a Weapon.
descriptions.zh: 用来大幅度强化武器的奥罗金改造科技。能使武器获得两倍的振幅晶体点数容量。

descriptions.en:
Ancient energy cell from the Orokin era.

Location: Ceres, Saturn, and Deimos
descriptions.zh:
奥罗金时代流传下来的远古能量电池。

获取地点：谷神星，土星和火卫二

descriptions.en: Reactor used to super-charge Warframes. Doubles the available Mod Capacity on a Warframe, Archwing, and Companions.
descriptions.zh: 反应堆用于大幅提升战甲的能力。且能将战甲、曲翼及同伴的振幅晶体容量提升为两倍。

descriptions.en:
Oxium is a rare lighter than air alloy of Orokin origin, used in certain Corpus Robotics.

Location: Venus, Jupiter, Mars, Neptune, Pluto, Eris, Europa, and Lua.
descriptions.zh:
奥席金属产于奥罗金，是一种比空气还轻的稀有合金，被用于部分科普斯机器人。

获取地点：金星，木星，火星，海王星，冥王星，阋神星，欧罗巴和月球。

descriptions.zh: 由圣装部件兑换的货币，可用于在虚空商人处购买商品。

descriptions.en:
Excess circuitry disposed of during the Razorback manufacturing process, these components only appear in the vicinity of high level outer-orbit Corpus facilities after a Razorback Armada has been launched.

Location: Corpus Archwing units on Jupiter and Neptune when a Razorback Armada is active
descriptions.zh:
制造利刃豺狼过程中的多余回路。在利刃豺狼舰队上阵后，这些组件只会出现在高等的科普斯外环设施之中。

获取地点：利刃豺狼舰队活动期间木星和海王星上的科普斯曲翼单位

descriptions.en:
A fragment of a sundered Riven. It is known that, with enough slivers, Palladino is capable of reforging a complete Riven. Find her in the Iron Wake (Earth) after completing The Chains of Harrow quest.

Location: Eximus units and Requiem Relics
descriptions.zh:
破裂的裂隙振幅晶体碎块。有了足够的碎块，帕拉迪诺就可以重铸一张完整的裂隙振幅晶体。完成《驱魔使者的枷锁》系列任务后可在钢铁守望（地球）中找到她。

获取地点：卓越者单位、安魂遗物

descriptions.en: Use this cipher to instantly complete one Veiled Riven Challenge at the cost of consuming the cipher.
descriptions.zh: 使用并消耗破解器即可立即完成一项尚未揭开的裂隙振幅晶体挑战。
可以在振幅晶体工作台使用，将裂隙振幅晶体属性从特殊可能性池中拼接成新的属性。

descriptions.en:
A jagged crystalline ore. Gives off radiant energy.

Location: Earth, Lua, Phobos, Europa, Pluto, Sedna, and the Void
descriptions.zh:
锯齿状的结晶矿。放出辐射能量。

获取地点：地球，月球，火卫一，欧罗巴，冥王星，赛德娜和虚空

Raw Orokin memory plasma. Varzia's Foundry can consume Aya to create Void Relics. Find her in Maroo's Bazaar on Mars.

Location: Void Missions and Bounties
descriptions.zh:
未加工的奥罗金记忆等离子。瓦奇娅的铸造厂可以消耗阿耶精华来制造虚空遗物。可在火星上麦罗的集市里找到她。

获取地点：虚空和赏金任务

descriptions.en:
A shard ripped from a Sentient Anomaly in the Veil Proxima. Little Duck is known to trade these for other exotic goods somewhere in Fortuna on Venus.

Location: Murex ships found in Veil Proxima nodes marked with a special flashing icon (Railjack)
descriptions.zh:
从面纱比邻星域中的灵煞异常事件中扯下的碎片。小鸭子会在福尔图娜的某个地方用异域货物交易这些碎片，她以这种交易被人所熟知。

获取地点：面纱比邻星域节点中标有特殊的闪烁图标（航道星舰）的骨螺战舰

descriptions.en:
Retrieved from the shores of a sacred fate dream.

Location: Saya's Visions on Earth
descriptions.zh:
取自神圣命运梦境的彼岸。

获取地点：萨娅的异象（地球）

descriptions.en: Increases plasma beam range.
descriptions.zh: 提升等离子光束的距离。

names.zh: 阳点等离子钻头范围改造器

descriptions.en: Mine in peace and avoid alerting nearby enemies with this drill silencing widget.
descriptions.zh: 用这个钻头消音改造器来和平地挖矿并避免让敌人警戒。

names.zh: 阳点等离子钻头消音改造器

descriptions.en:
Discharged specter particles form an inert dust that can be collected and re-energized for various robotic projects.

Location: Errant Specters in the Granum Void (Corpus Ship Tileset)
descriptions.zh:
释放的魅影粒子形成一种惰性粉尘，可以收集起来为各种机器人项目重新充能。

获取地点：格拉努虚空（科普斯飞船场景）中的游荡魅影

descriptions.en: Injected into a Fomorian Reactor this corruptor will imbalance the fuels. Critically imbalanced reactors will eventually implode, destroy the ship. Slow but effective, recommended for Solo Tenno.
descriptions.zh: 对巨人战舰反应堆注射这个污染物会造成燃料失调，失调的精密反应堆最后会发生聚爆，并摧毁船只，缓慢但是有效，推荐给独行天诺战士。

descriptions.en: Tokens of Teshin's Esteem earned from Incursion Alerts or Acolytes on The Steel Path. Can be exchanged for items that prove your warrior capabilities by visiting Teshin in any Relay.
descriptions.zh: 从钢铁之路侵袭警报任务或是追随者那里获取的代表泰辛尊严的代币。可被用来在任意中继站的泰辛处换取证明你战士能力的物品。

descriptions.zh:
一只抗血清注射器的部件。

descriptions.en:
This rare metal is foreign to the Origin System and can only be found in asteroids that have made the long journey from other stars.

Location: Archwing Missions on Uranus
descriptions.zh:
这种罕见的金属来自始源星系之外，只能从来自其他恒星的小行星上获得。

获取地点：天王星上的曲翼任务

descriptions.en: Injecting this fluid into a Warframe will imbue it with the ability to fight autonomously alongside the Operator. Injection requires the use of the Helminth Infirmary, and the ability wears off after 24 hours.
descriptions.zh: 将这种液体注入战甲内，使其具有与指挥官并肩作战的能力。注射需要使用赫明斯巢体医务间，并且该能力会在 24 小时后消失。

descriptions.en: Fuses with a Warframe to unlock the Exilus Mod Slot.
descriptions.zh: 融入一架战甲来解锁特殊功能槽。

names.zh: 战甲特殊功能槽连接器

descriptions.en: Use the Elemental Vice to change the Elemental Damage Type of an Adversary Weapon.
descriptions.zh: 使用元素恶癖来改变对手武器的元素伤害类型。

descriptions.zh:
一种用来增加遗物内在能力的物质。

获取地点：虚空裂缝任务

descriptions.en: Nakak in Cetus would probably like these. Maybe she'll trade something special for them.

descriptions.en:
A volatile mushroom with an acrid odor similar to freshly detonated explosives. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
一种挥发性蘑菇，散发着类似刚引爆的炸药的刺鼻气味。把它带到气密舱夜帽那里以获取更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
This bizarre mushroom appears to be permanently frozen. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种古怪的蘑菇似乎被永久冻住了。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处来了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
This mushroom appears to continually excrete a highly acidic mucus. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种蘑菇似乎会不断分泌强酸性的黏液。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
This fungus appears to emit an electric charge. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种真菌似乎会释放电荷。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
This gaseous mushroom exhibits a terrible stench. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种气态蘑菇散发出难闻的恶臭。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
This mushroom is always hot to the touch. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种蘑菇摸起来总是炽热的。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
This mushroom is hard as an anvil and nearly as heavy. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种蘑菇坚硬如铁砧，重量也几乎相当。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
An oddly shaped fungus that will latch itself onto metallic objects. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
一种形状古怪的真菌，会附着在金属物体上。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽那里了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
This mushroom is as plain as plain can be. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种蘑菇普通得不能再普通了。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
Avoid stepping on this sharp, spear-like mushroom cap. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
小心别踩到这种尖锐如长矛般的蘑菇伞盖。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
A potentially radioactive mushroom. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
一种可能具有放射性的蘑菇。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
The spines on this mushroom appear to be extremely sharp. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种蘑菇上的尖刺看起来极为锋利。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
A peculiar looking mushroom that seems not of this world. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
一种外观奇特，仿佛不属于这个世界的蘑菇。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
A snake-like mushroom that should be handled with caution.  Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
一种蛇形的蘑菇，处理时应格外小心。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

descriptions.en:
This multi-capped mushroom should probably not be ingested. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
descriptions.zh:
这种多伞盖的蘑菇最好不要食用。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

This common plant can only be found during the day. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Sunlight Threshcone plants that grow on Earth
descriptions.zh:
这种常见的植物只能在白天找到。

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的日光去壳毬果植物获得。

This common plant can only be found at night. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Moonlight Threshcone plants that grow on Earth

这种常见的植物只能在黑夜找到。

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的月光去壳毬果植物获得。

descriptions.en:
This plant was introduced to arid regions across the Origin System, for its ability to collect moisture in harsh environments. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Ruk's Claw plants that grow on Mars
descriptions.zh:
这种植物被引进遍布于始源星系的干旱地带，储存水分的能力使其得以对抗严酷的环境。 

获取地点：通过采集生长在火星的鲁克之爪植物获得

descriptions.en: Extracted from Skateweed.
descriptions.zh: 从鳐鱼草中萃取出的精华物。

descriptions.en:
One of the few known plant species able to thrive on asteroids in deep space. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Vestan Moss plants that grow on Mercury, Saturn, and Sedna
descriptions.zh:
为数不多的能够在外太空小行星上繁衍生息的已知植物物种之一。 

获取地点：通过采集生长在水星、土星和赛德娜上的灶神藓植物获得

descriptions.en: Extracted from a Cerulean Fungus colony.
descriptions.zh: 从蔚蓝菌群中萃取出的精华物。

descriptions.en: Extracted from a Ghost Brush.
descriptions.zh: 从鬼影之拂中萃取出的精华物。

descriptions.en:
This rare plant can only be found during the day. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Sunlight Jadeleaf plants that grow on Earth
descriptions.zh:
这种稀有的植物只能在白天找到。 

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的日光玉叶植物获得。

descriptions.en:
This rare plant can only be found at night. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Moonlight Jadeleaf plants that grow on Earth
descriptions.zh:
这种稀有的植物只能在黑夜找到。 

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的月光玉叶植物获得。

descriptions.en:
This uncommon plant can only be found during the day. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Sunlight Dragonlily plants that grow on Earth
descriptions.zh:
这种罕见的植物只能在白天找到。

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的日光龙百合植物获得。

descriptions.en:
This uncommon plant can only be found at night. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Moonlight Dragonlily plants that grow on Earth
descriptions.zh:
这种罕见的植物只能在黑夜找到。

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的月光龙百合植物获得。

descriptions.en:
This resilient plant provides a natural food source in frigid areas of the Origin system. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Frostleaf plants that grow on Venus, Neptune, and Pluto
descriptions.zh:
这种坚韧不拔的植物为始源星系的寒冷地区提供了天然的食物来源。 

获取地点：通过扫采集生长在金星、海王星和冥王星上的霜叶植物获得

descriptions.en:
This robust, carnivorous plant has adapted to conditions in polluted waters. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Dusklight Sarracenia plants growing in Grineer Shipyards found commonly on Ceres
descriptions.zh:
这种强壮的食虫植物已经适应了在污染水域下生存。 

获取地点：通过采集常见于谷神星，生长在克隆尼造船厂的尘光瓶子草植物获取

descriptions.en:
This carnivorous plant can be found growing in the wilderness on Lua. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Lunar Pitcher plants that grow on Lua
descriptions.zh:
这种食虫植物可以在月球的荒野之中找到。 

获取地点：通过采集生长在月球的月之猪笼草植物获得

descriptions.en:
Formed over billions of years, these crystals are most often found embedded in space rock.

Location: Railjack Missions
descriptions.zh:
这些晶体形成了数十亿年，最常被发现嵌入太空岩石中。

获取地点：航道星舰任务

descriptions.en:
Once installed, these delicate power systems fuse with a Corpus Obelisk's engines. Unused capacitors are therefore, highly prized.

Location: Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas
descriptions.zh:
安装后，这些精致的电源系统将与科普斯方尖碑引起融为一体。因此，未被使用的电容器非常珍贵。 

获取地点：比邻星域（金星、海王星、冥王星）中的航道星舰任务

descriptions.en: A rare bacterial entity that increases the spread of Infestation found on Infested Ships.
descriptions.zh: 一种罕见的细菌实体，可以促进感染战舰上发现的感染的扩散传播

descriptions.en:
Resilient components used to reinforce the plated sheets of metal strapped to Grineer Ships.

Location: Eximus units in the Grineer Shipyard Tileset, and Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas
descriptions.zh:
用于加固绑在克隆尼战舰上的镀金板的弹性部件。

获取地点：克隆尼船坞场景中的卓越者单位、比邻星域（地球、土星、面纱）中的航道星舰任务

descriptions.en:
A cell of encapsulated Void energy.

Location: Lua
descriptions.zh:
一个封装着虚空能量的单元。

获取地点：月球

descriptions.en:
Vital components used in the creation of Corpus photon-networks.

Location: Eximus units in the Corpus Ice Planet Tileset, and Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas
descriptions.zh:
用于创建科普斯光子网络的重要部件。

获取地点：科普斯冰原星球场景中的卓越者单位、比邻星域（金星、海王星、冥王星）中的航道星舰任务

descriptions.en: A rare Orokin material used to create a tear in space and allow safe passage through the Void.
descriptions.zh: 一种稀有的奥罗金材料，用于撕裂空间以安全通过虚空。

descriptions.en:
Antimatter fuel cell that powers the Grineer Ships.

Location: Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas
descriptions.zh:
为克隆尼战舰提供动力的反物质燃料电池。

获取地点：比邻星域（地球、土星、面纱）中的航道星舰任务

descriptions.en:
A self-replicating fluid comprised of nanoproxies capable of independently repairing worn and damaged systems.

Location: Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas
descriptions.zh:
一种由纳米机器人组成并且能自我复制的液体，能够独立修复磨损和损坏的系统。

获取地点：比邻星域（金星、海王星、冥王星）中的航道星舰任务

descriptions.en: Orokin devices used for navigating the solar winds.
descriptions.zh: 用于应对太阳风的奥罗金设备。

descriptions.en:
A component used in secure Grineer communication networks.

Location: Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas
descriptions.zh:
一块用于确保克隆尼通信网络安全的组件。

获取地点：比邻星域（地球、土星、面纱）中的航道星舰任务

descriptions.en:
Nullstones do not conform to several laws of physics, making them highly prized for optimizing sensitive components.

Location: Railjack Missions
descriptions.zh:
虚无碎片并不符合几条重要的物理定律，因其可用于高灵敏度部件的优化而非常珍贵。

获取地点：航道星舰任务

descriptions.en:
A parasitic growth that often infects Eximus units operating in Infested environs.

Location: Eris
descriptions.zh:
在感染者环境中的卓越者单位经常受到的一种寄生物感染。

获取地点：阋神星

descriptions.en:
High-density alloy armor plating used in the construction of offensive spacecraft.

Location: Railjack Missions
descriptions.zh:
用于建造攻击性战舰的高致密合金装甲板。

获取地点：航道星舰任务

descriptions.en:
This highly malleable metal was exploited in great quantities by the Orokin and can now only be found within space rock.

Location: Railjack Missions
descriptions.zh:
这种柔软的金属曾被奥罗金过度开采，现在只能在太空陨石里找到。

获取地点：航道星舰任务

descriptions.en: An organ found on Infested Ships believed to facilitate communication within the Infested Hivemind.
descriptions.zh: 一种在感染者飞船上发现的器官，被认为能促进感染者蜂巢群体思维的交流。

descriptions.en: An integral building block in the construction of Tenno relays.
descriptions.zh: 天诺中继站构造中的一个组成部分。

descriptions.en: With a blazing orange hue and rigid material strength, this compound is prized by ship and station architects.
descriptions.zh: 这种化合物具有炽热的橙色色调和坚硬的材料强度，受到船舰及中继站建筑师的青睐。

descriptions.en: A highly purified mineral compound prized for its strength, resiliency, and resistance to heat. Widely used in the construction of Tenno relays.
descriptions.zh: 高纯度矿物质化合物，因其强度，弹性和耐热性而备受推崇。广泛用于天诺中继站的建造。

descriptions.en:
This living mass can produce weaponized toxins for weaponry.

Location: Clan Research (Bio Lab in the Dojo) and Infested Outbreak Invasion Rewards
descriptions.zh:
此生体聚合物可以制造出可供武器使用的毒素。 

获取地点：生物实验室（氏族道场）和异变感染体爆发奖励

descriptions.en:
These samples could advance our knowledge of biological research.

Location: Eris and Deimos
descriptions.zh:
这些样本有助于使我们的生物研究水平更进一步。

获取地点：阋神星和火卫二。

descriptions.en:
Detonite injectors are the basis for explosive and incendiary weapons.

Location: Clan Research (Chem Lab in the Dojo) and Grineer Invasion Rewards
descriptions.zh:
爆燃喷射器是爆炸和燃烧类武器的基础。

获取地点：化学实验室（氏族道场）和克隆尼入侵任务奖励

descriptions.en:
Researching the Detonite traces within could advance our weapon technology.

Location: Venus, Earth, Lua, Ceres, Saturn, Sedna, and the Kuva Fortress
descriptions.zh:
对爆燃安瓿内的残留物进行研究，可推动我们的武器技术。

获取地点：金星，地球，月球，谷神星，土星，赛德娜和赤毒要塞。

descriptions.en: A cipher used to decode Corpus intel. Crafting component required to create a CORPUS VOID KEY
descriptions.zh: 一种用来破解科普斯商会电脑密码的解码器。制造科普斯商会虚空钥匙组件所必要的组件。

descriptions.en: A Corpus datamass containing encrypted intel. Crafting component required to create a CORPUS VOID KEY
descriptions.zh: 一个内含加密情报的科普斯商会数据块。制造科普斯商会虚空钥匙组件所必要的组件。

descriptions.en:
ClanTech weaponized containment field to contain superheated substances.

Location: Clan Research (Energy Lab in the Dojo) and Corpus Invasion Rewards
descriptions.zh:
氏族技术人员利用能量包围力场控制高热能物质以利于武器化。

获取地点：（道场中）能源实验室的氏族研究和科普斯入侵任务奖励

descriptions.en:
This destroyed Fieldron could further research into super-heated containment fields.

Location: Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Europa, Neptune, and Pluto
descriptions.zh:
借由损坏的电磁力场装置可促进有关高热能物质能量包围力场方面的研究。

获取地点：金星，火星，木星，欧罗巴，海王星和冥王星。

descriptions.en: For a limited time, adds festive decorations to your Orbiter!
descriptions.zh: 在限定时间内，为你的轨道飞行器添加各种节庆装饰吧！

descriptions.en: Install this segment in order to enable the Arsenal within your orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 将此模块安装在轨道飞行器上以启用军械库功能。

descriptions.en: Strengthen your Arsenal with Melee Arcanes. This segment unlocks Exilus Slots for your Melee Weapons.
descriptions.zh: 通过近战武器赋能强化你的军械库。这个模块会为你的近战武器解锁特殊功能槽。

descriptions.en: A foundry upgrade that allows two Forma to be crafted at the same time.
descriptions.zh: 允许在同一时间制造两个塑形块的铸造厂升级。

descriptions.en:
Upgrades the Orbiter's Foundry with the following features:

- Allows construction of Landing Craft
- Allows construction of Air Support Charges

Equip Air Support Charges in your Loadout's Gear.
descriptions.zh:
将轨道飞行器的铸造厂升级，可获得下列功能：

－可以制造登陆艇
－可以制造空中支持呼叫道具

在「军械库」>「携带装备」中装备「空中支援呼叫器」。

descriptions.en: Allows the Incubator to breed Kavats.
descriptions.zh: 可以让孵化器繁殖库娃。

descriptions.en: Install this segment to enable the pet incubator within your Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 将此模块安装在轨道飞行器上以启用宠物孵化器功能。

descriptions.en:
Upgrades the Orbiter's Incubator with the following features:

- Regress genetic aging of mature companions
- Egg incubation reduced by a day
descriptions.zh:
升级轨道飞行器的孵化器来获得以下功能：

- 回退受老化基因影响的成熟同伴
- 孵化时间减少一天

descriptions.en: Allows the Helminth to socket Archon Shards in the current Warframe. Archon Shards permanently enhance various stats.
descriptions.zh: 该模块允许赫明斯巢体将执刑官源力石嵌入当前战甲。执刑官源力石可以永久增强多种属性。

names.zh: 赫明斯巢体执刑官源力石模块

descriptions.en: Allows the Helminth to fuse Archon Shards into more powerful variants through Coalescent Fusion and Ascent Fusion.
descriptions.zh: 通过联结融合和升华融合，可让赫明斯巢体融合执刑官源力石来获得更强大的源力石变体。

descriptions.en: Empower the Helminth in your Orbiter and unlock the transfer of new abilities to your Warframes.
descriptions.zh: 在轨道飞行器强化赫明斯巢体，并解锁将新技能转移到战甲上的功能。

descriptions.en: Allows The Helminth to inject a Warframe with an Invigoration. Invigorations temporarily increase a Warframe's capabilities.
descriptions.zh: 允许赫明斯巢体为战甲注入活力。活化可以暂时增加战甲的能力。

descriptions.en: Install this segment to enable the Mod Fusion function within the MODS terminal of your Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 将此模块安装在轨道飞行器的振幅晶体终端机上以解锁振幅晶体融铸功能。

descriptions.en: A Railjack Command Cephalon. Responsible for ships systems, mission completion and crew preservation.
descriptions.zh: 航道星舰指挥中枢。负责战舰系统、任务完成以及舰员保护。

descriptions.en: Resembling a Void Key, this object appears to be a perfect match for the empty slot in the Railjack's reliquary.
descriptions.zh: 与虚空钥匙类似，这个物品明显与航道星舰里圣物装置的钥匙孔相匹配。

descriptions.en: Install this Void Relic Segment in your Orbiter to begin opening Void Relics. Void Relics contain valuables that are only determined when opened in Void Fissure missions. Void Relics can be obtained as mission rewards.
descriptions.zh: 将此虚空遗物模块安装到你的轨道飞行器上，即可开启虚空遗物。虚空遗物内含的宝物只有在虚空裂缝任务中开启后才能确定。虚空遗物可以作为任务奖励获得。

descriptions.en:
The Taxmen call it an investment in our future, but loans to cover vocational and specialist training almost always cost more than you'll ever earn. Especially with the interest.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
descriptions.zh:
税务官将其称为对我们未来的投资，但是用来支付职业和专业培训的贷款几乎超过你的收入。尤其还有利息。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）报价员处购得

descriptions.en:
Covers everything from hab rent to insurance, docking permits and paying off that rail tractor. Big ticket items.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
descriptions.zh:
涵盖从栖所租金到保险，登陆许可和支付航道船舰的所有费用。高价物品。

descriptions.en:
To get work you need mods. Then you need more work to pay for the mods, so you get more mods. And here we are.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
descriptions.zh:
要有更多工作，你需要改装。然后你需要更多的工作来支付改装，这样你才能得到更多的改装。所以我们现在才会这样。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）报价员处购得

descriptions.en:
Sometimes a rig jockey needs a helping hand, so they get an advance on the next pay. Massive interest rates almost guarantee they'll be paying that off forever.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
descriptions.zh:
有时候一个技工需要一些帮助，所以他们可以预支下一次的工资。高额利率几乎可以保证他们将一辈子来偿还这笔费用。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）报价员处购得

descriptions.en:
Debts unpaid by one generation are passed to the next. Working to pay them off is seen as something to be proud of. What choice do they have?

descriptions.en:
Primary: Long-range proboscis attaches to a target and then splits off to attack up to three more enemies.
Secondary: Three short-range proboscises fiercely latch onto targets and maul them.
descriptions.zh:
主武器：远距口器附着在一个目标上，然后分裂开来攻击至多 3 名敌人。
副武器：三个短距口器猛烈地卡住目标，并对其进行攻击。

descriptions.en:
Primary: Launches spore-sacs that explode with toxic mist on each bounce. Automatic trigger.
Secondary: Fires spore-sacs that rupture into three smaller toxic projectiles on impact. Semi-automatic trigger.

副武器：发射孢子囊，撞击时会破裂成三个较小的毒性投射物。半自动扳机。

descriptions.en: Cradles a large-volume, quick-charge capacitor to unleash a wide, killing beam.
descriptions.zh: 支撑着一颗大容量，快充的电容来释放一道宽阔的致命光束。

descriptions.en: Heavyweight, shock-absorbing scaffold capable of short-range, wide-angle flak blast.
descriptions.zh: 重量级、减震支架能支持短程、广角高射炮爆破。

descriptions.en: Elegant and finely-calibrated proton aggregator latches onto a target and hoses them down.
descriptions.zh: 优雅和精密校准过的质子聚集器锁定在目标上并向他们连续射击。

descriptions.en: Additional microcapacitors are laced within the armpiece's substructure. Increased ammunition.
descriptions.zh: 臂件的底部构造内装有额外的微型电容，增加弹药。

descriptions.en: An array of heat sinks reduce recharge delays.
descriptions.zh: 一组散热片阵列减少再充能的延迟。

descriptions.en: The armpiece doubles as a throttled overcharger, increasing the likelihood of Critical Hits and Status Chance.
descriptions.zh: 这个臂件可以充当一个节流超载器，增加暴击几率和触发几率。

descriptions.en: Pulses Void energy through a fine-cut pavilion to riddle targets with flashing fire.
descriptions.zh: 精工切割的棱面中脉冲出一道虚空能量，以闪烁的火光困惑目标。

descriptions.en: Launch energy discs that ricochet off victims and surfaces, vectoring toward a new target with each strike.
descriptions.zh: 发射出一枚在敌人与地面弹跳的能量圆盘，每发攻击后都会导向新目标。

descriptions.en: A dual-purpose brace that reduces Void energy regeneration delay, and decreases regeneration time, though not as quickly as a single-purpose brace.
descriptions.zh: 一把具有双重用途的曲柄。它既能降低虚空能量再生所需的延迟，亦可缩短再生的时间，但效率未如单一功能的曲柄来得高。

descriptions.en: Hold tight and unleash hell. Increased range for beam weapons; increased rate-of-fire for non-beam weapons. Reduced damage.
descriptions.zh: 紧握它并释放出地狱般的伤害。光束武器的射程范围增大；非光束武器的射速提高。较低伤害。

descriptions.en: Trades lower Damage for faster Fire Rate and more controlled Recoil.
descriptions.zh: 以较低的伤害换取更高的射速，并且更容易控制后坐力。

descriptions.en: The weapon grip of the measured killer. Slower Fire Rate and lower Range for Beam Weapons. High Damage with Recoil to match.
descriptions.zh: 给精心计算的杀手所设计的握把。较低的射速，并且光束武器的射程范围较低。具有高伤害和与之匹配的后坐力。

descriptions.en: High Damage with Recoil to match. Slower Fire Rate.
descriptions.zh: 具有高伤害和与之相匹配的后坐力。射速较低。

descriptions.en:
Secondary: Fires a wide-radius plasma energy projectile with a very short half-life.
Primary: Automatic trigger, faster fire rate and smaller projectiles.
descriptions.zh:
副武器：发射一道具有极短半衰期的宽幅等离子体。
主武器：自动扳机，具有更快的射速和更小的投射物。

descriptions.en:
Secondary: fires projectiles semi-automatically with high accuracy; area-of-effect explosion on impact.
Primary: hold fire to charge for an even greater effect.
descriptions.zh:
副武器：半自动化发射具有高精准度的投射物；撞击时会产生范围爆炸伤害。
主武器：按住射击来充能，以获得更具破坏性的伤害。

descriptions.en: Let ‘er rip, rapid-fire.
descriptions.zh: 让他们安息吧，有速射特性。

descriptions.en:
Secondary: a persistent cutting beam of pure energy.
Primary: same as Secondary, but with explosion on impact.
descriptions.zh:
副武器：可产生持久的纯粹能量切割光束。
主武器：与副武器的攻击相同，但可以在撞击时产生爆炸伤害。
